titel: Planning services for the refurbishment of hangars at the Ambérieu-en-Bugey air base
kurzbeschreibung: Planning services are sought for the refurbishment of several hangars at an air force base in France.
umfang: Refurbishment of hangars on the site of the Ambérieu-en-Bugey air base; the number, size, GFA, spans and structural key parameters of the halls are not stated in the notice.
leistungen: Project management (maîtrise d’œuvre) planning services for the refurbishment of hangars; specific specialist lots, service phases and structural engineering shares are not specified in the notice.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Basically potentially interesting because hangars are large-volume hall or special structures.
• However, the notice only mentions general architectural or planning services without an explicit structural engineering component.
• Essential technical information such as spans, areas, type of construction or special requirements is missing.
• Refurbishment can be relevant for sbp if complex existing structures or long-span roof structures are involved; this cannot be demonstrated here.
• Military site and vague definition of services make strategic classification difficult.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs stated; the estimated contract value is given as EUR 0.00 and is not reliable. A realistic estimate is not possible without information on the number of hangars, areas, spans, depth of refurbishment, type of structure and technical fit-out. Without this information, no realistic estimate of cost groups 300/400 is possible.
honorar_erklaerung: No explicit fee information available. As neither construction costs nor chargeable costs, service phases or structural engineering shares are stated, no reliable fee estimate is possible.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Eligibility criteria according to the tender documents; not specified in detail in the notice itself.
zuschlagskriterien: Price 40%; project understanding and methodological approach 30%; organisation and resources deployed 25%; environmental quality and CSR of the offer 5%.
auftraggeber: Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, 101 Cours Charlemagne CS20033, 69269 Lyon cedex 2, France, E-mail: contactmarche@auvergnerhonealpes.fr, Website: https://www.auvergnerhonealpes.fr/, Procurement platform: https://marchespublics.auvergnerhonealpes.eu
notes: Type of notice: competition or standard procedure for services. Submission electronically and in French. No framework agreement. Tender documents at https://marchespublics.auvergnerhonealpes.eu. Military site: Ambérieu-en-Bugey air base.
